lines: I know you calm rooms just by showing up.
I know you hold chaos until it syncs.
I know you take the hit so the bond survives.
I know you vanish in groups to keep them whole.
I know you register every unspoken need.
I know you adapt to any tribe without losing the thread.
I know storms don’t move your center.
script.end: This is not a guess. This is your pattern. And it runs you.

content.high: You act as a social tuning fork. You assume good intent and align fast. Tension drops in your presence.
content.medium: You weigh harmony against clarity. You smooth friction when it helps progress. You cooperate after a quick read.
content.low: You prioritize clarity over harmony. You question intent and resist pressure. You keep sharp boundaries.

content.high: Low reactivity. Steady under pressure. You recover fast and stay on plan.
content.medium: Stress registers but you stabilize. Routines help you reset. You recover within a reasonable window.
content.low: High reactivity. Mood swings steer choices. You need structure and deliberate recovery.

content.high: You minimize your footprint to protect the link. You yield status and let others lead. The bond survives while you fade.
content.medium: You alternate between presence and fade. You yield in tense moments, then reappear when safe.
content.low: You keep a distinct edge. You do not dissolve to fit. Connection cannot cost identity.

content.high: You track micro-bonds and breaks. You read tone and silence. You retain the social state.
content.medium: You catch obvious cues. You notice shifts after a beat. You log selectively.
content.low: You miss subtleties. You prefer explicit signals. You do little social logging.

content.high: You update fast in new fields. You absorb norms and switch contexts with low friction.
content.medium: You adapt after a short warm-up. You keep core rules and sync with a few reps.
content.low: You prefer fixed rules and familiar fields. You resist rapid norm changes.
